title: The Advanced Custom Fields (ACF®) WordPress plugin before 6.8.11 does not perform a read-permission check when it…
description: The Advanced Custom Fields (ACF®) WordPress plugin versions prior to 6.8.11 lack a read-permission check when rendering and formatting relational field values. This flaw allows users with post-editing capabilities (Contributor role and above) to view titles and non-public statuses of unpublished posts owned by other users.
